integrity: Proof includes explicit normalized root coordinates, reproducing-kernel decompositions, all-degree bounds and independent exact integer/rational checker.
scientific_limitations: The degree-10 constant-sector vanishing and E8 root-line graph are prior results. Complete exact-degree interpolation ranks and their infinite tail are evaluated here; literature coverage is bounded and an independent audit remains outstanding.
title: Exact-degree harmonic interpolation ranks on the 240 E8 roots
